Defines Go structs for deserializing Ubuntu OVAL (Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language) XML definitions used to represent vulnerability assessment data.

## Key Components

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `Root` | Top-level struct mapping to the `<oval_definitions>` XML root element |
| `Definition` | Represents a single OVAL definition with metadata, affected platforms, references, and criteria |
| `Criteria` / `Criterion` | Recursive criteria tree used to evaluate vulnerability conditions |
| `Textfilecontent54Test` | OVAL test referencing object/state pairs for file content checks |
| `Textfilecontent54Object` | Defines the file path, filename, and regex pattern to inspect |
| `Textfilecontent54State` | Defines the expected state (e.g., version subexpression) to match against |
| `ConstantVariable` | OVAL variable holding constant values referenced by objects/tests |
| `dpkgInfoTest` | Internal struct pairing a package name with its fixed version for vulnerability resolution |

## Usage Example

```go
import (
    "encoding/xml"
    "os"
)

func parseOVAL(path string) (*Root, error) {
    data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }

    var root Root
    if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &root); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }

    // Iterate vulnerability definitions
    for _, def := range root.Definitions.Definitions {
        _ = def.Title       // e.g. "USN-1234-1: openssl vulnerability"
        _ = def.Advisory.Severity  // e.g. "High"
        for _, ref := range def.References {
            _ = ref.RefID  // e.g. "CVE-2023-12345"
        }
    }

    return &root, nil
}
```

The struct hierarchy mirrors the OVAL XML schema: `Root` → `Definitions` → `Definition` → `Criteria` → `Criterion`, with `Tests`, `Objects`, `States`, and `Variables` sections cross-referenced by ID.
